advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a regression test: commit a .gitattributes carrying `.reconciler-* merge=ours`, run the gitattributes ensure-unit, assert outcome is `ok` and the committed blob is unchanged (retired line still present, no new commit).
evidence: release-notes states the breaking contract: docs/release-notes.md:21-22 "reports `ok`/\".gitattributes converged\" for any tracker that has one. A clone last swept **before 2026-07-05** that still carries the retired line will no longer be converged by `init`"

src/rebar/_commands/init.py:590 surviving branch does no content check: `return EnsureOutcome("gitattributes", "ok", ".gitattributes converged")` -- reached whenever `show.returncode == 0` regardless of blob contents

The deleted test was the only one that committed a .gitattributes carrying `.reconciler-*` (diff removes `test_gitattributes_migration_strips_retired_reconciler_line`), and the retargeted S3 scenario now does `_git(tracker, "rm", "-q", ".gitattributes")` (tests/interfaces/store/test_ensure_drift_matrix.py:86), i.e. missing-file drift, not retired-line-present drift
ABSENCE: no test asserts that a committed .gitattributes carrying the retired line is reported `ok` and left byte-for-byte unmodified after a sweep
advisory.finding: The new documented contract -- a tracker carrying an already-committed `.gitattributes` (specifically one still carrying the retired `.reconciler-* merge=ours` line) is now left UNMODIFIED and reported `ok` (no longer stripped) -- has no regression test. The only test exercising a committed .gitattributes carrying the retired line (`test_gitattributes_migration_strips_retired_reconciler_line`) was deleted, and the drift-matrix S3 scenario was retargeted to a missing-file case. The surviving `ok` branch is content-agnostic (it only checks blob existence), so a regression that re-introduces stripping/rewriting of an existing committed .gitattributes, or one where a legacy/non-canonical committed blob is mis-handled, would not be caught.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a test to test_gitattributes_merge.py that commits a .gitattributes containing the retired `.reconciler-* merge=ours` line, runs run_ensures (or re-init), then asserts the gitattributes outcome is `ok`, no new commit was made, and the committed blob still equals the original content (retired line intact) -- pinning the create-only, leave-existing-untouched contract.
